data.rationale: The proposal captures the core flow (Find a Park by State, select state, then open a park or section link), but it only parameterizes state, leaves park and section as vague "a park, heritage area, or Basic Information link", and adds a homepage-open step that isn't in the true workflow, so an automation would have to guess the final click.
